name: Bowler Metcalf Limited
source: CRON 2026-10-13: FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026) column added. Audited by Moore Cape Town Incorporated with an unmodified opinion, per the issuer's SENS short form announcement of 8 September 2026. Issuer-printed anchors: revenue 952,869 and operating profit 161,856 (R thousands, annual report financial highlights page 2); profit after tax 136,999 and earnings per share 200.20 cents (same page); profit before tax 186.7 and profit after tax 137.0 R million (SENS short form). Cost of sales 651,530 from stockanalysis.com in millions ZAR, where the same source reproduces the stored FY2025 revenue 945.851 and cost of sales 674.297 to the thousand. Derived so the printed column ties: gross profit 952,869 less 651,530 equals 301,339; operating expenses 301,339 less the printed 161,856 equals 139,483; net finance costs 161,856 less 186,720 equals minus 24,864, i.e. net finance income of 24,864 (the issuer's financial highlights define operating profit as profit before tax and net finance income); income tax 186,720 less 136,999 equals 49,721, against a source tax expense of 49.72 million. Both printed identities tie exactly on the stored column: revenue 952,869 less cost of sales 651,530 equals gross profit 301,339, and profit before tax 186,720 less income tax 49,721 equals net profit 136,999. Ratio rows for FY2026 recomputed from the FY2026 balance figures: return on equity 14.22 per cent against the 14.2 printed in the annual report highlights; gross margin 31.62 per cent and net margin 14.38 per cent, both reproducing the published figures. Source pages: https://sharedata.co.za/v2/scripts/SENS.aspx?id=559647 and https://stockanalysis.com/quote/jse/BCF/financials/income-statement/ | previous source: Yahoo Finance
